welcome.text: Hello Clover. Welcome to your little world. Shall we visit our friends, or make your very own monster?

explore.text: Move with the stick, or the arrow keys. Follow the pictures to meet your friends. Press the green A button when you get close.

home.text: Welcome home! Let's make this place your own. You can move your furniture, plant a seed, and give your flowers a little water.

map.text: Where shall we go? Choose a picture to visit a friend.

pause.text: Time for a little rest. Your adventure will be right here.

creator.text: Let's make your monster. Choose any colours, change your shape, and try some lovely things to wear.

garden.text: Choose a seed, then an empty patch of soil. Give it three little drinks to help it grow.

furniture.text: Choose something you own, then choose a space to put it. You can move it again whenever you like.

bought.text: That's yours now! Thank you, little friend. Take it home and find a lovely place for it.

expensive.text: A few more stars will buy that. Our friends have lots of little jobs you can help with.

owned.text: You already have that! You can find it at home.

planted.text: A tiny seed, tucked into the soil. Now let's give it some water.

watered.text: A lovely little drink. Look how your plant is growing!

grown.text: You grew it all by yourself. What a beautiful garden!

bramble-hello.text: Hello there! I'm Bramble. Welcome to my pizza shop! Our friends have brought some lovely recipes. Will you help me count the toppings and make their pizzas?

olive-hello.text: Hello, little monster. I'm Olive. The wind has scattered the sounds from my storybook. Let's listen, and put the words together again.

marina-hello.text: Ahoy, little friend! I'm Marina. My little boats are ready to deliver fish around the island. Can you help me send them on their way?

tilly-hello.text: Hello! I'm Tilly. I love growing things. Let's put our flowers together, and make a beautiful path through the garden.

poppy-hello.text: Welcome to my little shops! I'm Poppy. Spend your stars on something cosy for your house, or a little treasure for your garden.

pip-hello.text: Oh, hello! I'm Pip. My rocket had a rather bumpy landing. Could you help me mend three broken parts? Then we can fly to the moon together!

nova-hello.text: You made it to the moon! I'm Nova. Look at all those stars. Let's discover a few things about our solar system.

pip-repaired.text: You did it! The control panel, fuel tank, and star battery are all ready. Hop aboard when you're ready. We're going to the moon!

launch.text: Ready, little explorer? Three, two, one, blast off! Next stop, the moon!

return.text: Let's head home. Our friends and your garden will be waiting for us.

part.text: Wonderful! That's another part of the rocket mended. We're one step closer to the moon.

complete.text: You did it! Two lovely stars for helping your friend. Shall we play again, or explore?

again.text: Let's have another go. Take your time. We can work it out together.

learn-sound.text: Let's learn a new sound. Listen carefully, then say it with me. Now find the letters that match.

find-sound.text: Listen to the sound. Which letters make that sound?

grown-up.text: Let's ask a grown-up to say this sound with us. Then you can find the matching letters.

add.text: How many flowers are there altogether? Choose your number, then press the green button.

pattern.text: The control panel has a pattern. Look along the coloured shapes. Which shape comes next?

battery.text: How many star batteries are there altogether? Choose your number, then press the green button.

earth.text: Our home planet is called Earth. It has blue oceans and green land. Can you find Earth?

sun.text: The Sun is a star. It gives us light and warmth. Can you find the Sun?

saturn.text: Saturn has beautiful rings made of ice and rock. Can you find the planet with rings?

moon.text: The Moon travels around Earth. It shines by reflecting sunlight. Can you find the Moon?

put-away.text: All put away. There's room for something new.

ready.text: Looking lovely! Your monster is ready for an adventure.

sound-settings.text: These are the grown-up settings. You can change the learning range, and check the letter sounds.

numbers-help.text: You can touch each object and count along. There is no hurry.

pack-check.text: That basket is just right. Thank you for helping with our picnic!

help.text: Choose an object to move it. You can put it back if you change your mind. Press the tick when you are ready.

pack-1.text: Please put 1 apple in the picnic basket. Touch an apple to pack it. Touch it again to put it back.

fuel-1.text: We need 1 crystals. Choose that many, then press the green button.

stars-1.text: Let's collect 1 star for our moon map. Choose them, then press the tick.

take-1.text: 1 fish swim away. How many are left? Choose your number, then press the green button.

visit-meadow.text: Bramble is waving from his pizza shop. Press the green A button to help him make a pizza.

visit-home.text: Let's visit your home and garden.

bramble-success.text: Lovely work! You helped me. Here are two stars for your collection.

bramble-retry.text: Let's try again, little friend. Take your time, and have another look.

olive-success.text: Lovely work! You helped me. Here are two stars for your collection.

olive-retry.text: Let's try again, little friend. Take your time, and have another look.

pizza-order-woods.text: Hello! Could I have a woodland pizza, please? Here is my recipe. Work out each little puzzle to find how many toppings I would like. Thank you!

pizza-order-garden.text: Hello! Could I have a garden pizza, please? Here is my recipe. Work out each little puzzle to find how many toppings I would like. Thank you!

pizza-order-cove.text: Hello! Could I have a harbour pizza, please? Here is my recipe. Work out each little puzzle to find how many toppings I would like. Thank you!

pizza-order-rocket.text: Hello! Could I have a space pizza, please? Here is my recipe. Work out each little puzzle to find how many toppings I would like. Thank you!

topping-tomato.text: Let's count the tomatoes. Work out the recipe, then add them to the pizza, one at a time.

topping-mushroom.text: Let's count the mushrooms. Work out the recipe, then add them to the pizza, one at a time.

topping-pepper.text: Let's count the peppers. Work out the recipe, then add them to the pizza, one at a time.

topping-olive.text: Let's count the olives. Work out the recipe, then add them to the pizza, one at a time.

topping-sweetcorn.text: Let's count the pieces of sweetcorn. Work out the recipe, then add them to the pizza, one at a time.

pizza-plus-0-1.text: 0 plus 1. How many is that altogether?

pizza-minus-1-0.text: 1 take away 0. How many are left?

pizza-minus-1-1.text: 1 take away 1. How many are left?

pizza-plus-1-1.text: 1 plus 1. How many is that altogether?

pizza-minus-2-0.text: 2 take away 0. How many are left?

pizza-minus-2-1.text: 2 take away 1. How many are left?

pizza-plus-1-2.text: 1 plus 2. How many is that altogether?

pizza-minus-3-1.text: 3 take away 1. How many are left?

pizza-plus-2-2.text: 2 plus 2. How many is that altogether?

pizza-minus-4-1.text: 4 take away 1. How many are left?

pizza-minus-10-1.text: 10 take away 1. How many are left?

pizza-bake.text: All the toppings match the recipe! Into the oven it goes. What a wonderful pizza!

pizza-retry.text: Let’s count the recipe pictures. Choose how many toppings we need.

pizza-next.text: Lovely! Let’s add the next topping.

space-earth-home.text: Earth is our home. Can you find our blue and green planet?

space-sun-star.text: The Sun is a star. Which picture shows the Sun?

space-mars-red.text: Mars is called the red planet. Can you find Mars?

space-saturn-rings.text: Saturn has lovely wide rings. Can you find Saturn?

space-collect-1.text: Can you collect 1 star for our Moon station?

space-pattern-1.text: Our Moon station needs a picture code. Which picture comes next?

space-mercury-small.text: Mercury is the smallest planet. Find the little grey planet.

space-venus-hot.text: Venus is the hottest planet. Find the yellow cloudy planet.

space-jupiter-big.text: Jupiter is the biggest planet. Find the big stripy planet.

space-neptune-far.text: Neptune is the planet furthest from the Sun. Find the deep blue planet.

space-collect-2.text: Can you collect 2 Moon rocks for our Moon station?

space-pattern-2.text: Our Moon station needs a picture code. Which picture comes next?

space-uranus-roll.text: Uranus spins on its side. Can you find the pale blue planet?

space-moon-neighbour.text: The Moon travels around Earth. Can you find the grey Moon?

space-earth-oceans.text: Which planet has the oceans where whales swim?

space-earth-garden.text: Which planet has real trees and gardens for us to enjoy?

space-collect-3.text: Can you collect 3 crystals for our Moon station?

space-pattern-3.text: Our Moon station needs a picture code. Which picture comes next?

space-mercury-near.text: Mercury is closest to the Sun. Find Mercury, the little grey planet.

space-venus-clouds.text: Venus is wrapped in thick clouds. Find our yellow cloudy planet.

space-jupiter-storm.text: Jupiter has a giant storm called the Great Red Spot. Find the stripy planet with a spot.

space-mars-robots.text: Our robot rovers explore Mars. Find the red planet they drive on.

space-collect-4.text: Can you collect 4 toy rockets for our Moon station?

space-pattern-4.text: Our Moon station needs a picture code. Which picture comes next?

space-moon-craters.text: The Moon has lots of round craters. Find the grey, crater-covered Moon.

space-moon-visit.text: People have walked on the Moon. Can you find the Moon?

space-moon-reflects.text: The Moon reflects sunlight. Can you find the Moon?

space-collect-5.text: Can you collect 5 batteries for our Moon station?

space-pattern-5.text: Our Moon station needs a picture code. Which picture comes next?

space-rocket-launch.text: Which vehicle blasts off into space?

space-astronaut-job.text: An astronaut is a space explorer. Can you find the astronaut?

space-space-suit.text: Who is wearing a spacesuit to help them breathe in space?

space-telescope-look.text: A telescope helps us see faraway things in space. Find the telescope.

space-collect-6.text: Can you collect 2 Moon flowers for our Moon station?

space-pattern-6.text: Our Moon station needs a picture code. Which picture comes next?

space-satellite-orbit.text: Satellites travel around planets and send us information. Find the satellite.

space-moon-rocks.text: Astronauts brought Moon rocks home to study. Which picture shows a rock?

space-sun-warmth.text: Which star sends warmth to Earth?

space-earth-air.text: Earth has air we can breathe. Find our blue and green home.

space-collect-7.text: Can you collect 3 toy satellites for our Moon station?

space-pattern-7.text: Our Moon station needs a picture code. Which picture comes next?

space-mars-two-moons.text: Mars has two little moons. Find the red planet.

space-venus-no-moon.text: Venus has no moons. Can you find the yellow cloudy planet?

space-moon-low-gravity.text: You could jump higher on the Moon than on Earth. Find the Moon.

space-sun-centre.text: The planets travel around the Sun. Which picture belongs in the middle of our solar system?

space-collect-8.text: Can you collect 4 rocket bolts for our Moon station?

space-pattern-8.text: Our Moon station needs a picture code. Which picture comes next?

tutorial-hello.text: Hello! Let us learn the buttons together. Press the green A button to begin.

tutorial-move.text: Take your monster for a little walk. Use the control pad, or the stick.

tutorial-choose.text: Choose the apple. Move right on your control pad.

tutorial-confirm.text: Lovely! Press the green A button to choose it.

tutorial-back.text: The apple is in our basket. Press the red B button to go back.

tutorial-done.text: You did it! Green A says yes. Red B goes back. Yellow Y helps you listen again. Press A to explore.

demo-bramble-pizza.text: Watch me. One tomato, and one more tomato, makes two. Move right to choose two. Then press the green A button. Your turn!

demo-tilly-add.text: Watch me. One apple, and one more apple, makes two. Move right to choose two, then press the green A button. Your turn!

demo-marina-take.text: Watch me. Three apples. Take one away. Two are left. Move right to choose two, then press the green A button. Your turn!

demo-pip-pattern.text: Watch the pattern. Circle, triangle, circle. A triangle comes next. Choose the picture, then press the green A button. Your turn!

demo-pip-pack.text: Watch me pack two apples. One, two. Move right to choose two, then press the green A button. Your turn!

demo-pip-add.text: Watch me. One apple, and one more apple, makes two. Move right to choose two, then press the green A button. Your turn!

demo-olive-sound.text: First, listen to the sound with your grown-up. Then choose its letters, and press the green A button. Yellow Y lets you watch this again.

demo-olive-spell.text: Watch me choose the letters for a word. Choose each sound with the green A button. Blue X takes the last one back. Now try your word with your grown-up.

demo-nova-space.text: Look at the pictures. A rocket can fly into space. Choose its picture, then press the green A button. Your turn!

demo-nova-pattern.text: Watch the pattern. Circle, triangle, circle. A triangle comes next. Choose the picture, then press the green A button. Your turn!

demo-nova-pack.text: Watch me pack two apples. One, two. Move right to choose two, then press the green A button. Your turn!

hint-bramble-more.text: We need a few more. Look at the empty spaces. Move right to fill them.

hint-bramble-fewer.text: We have a few extra. Look at the marked pictures. Move left to take the extras away.

hint-tilly-more.text: We need a few more. Look at the empty spaces. Move right to fill them.

hint-tilly-fewer.text: We have a few extra. Look at the marked pictures. Move left to take the extras away.

hint-marina-more.text: We need a few more. Look at the empty spaces. Move right to fill them.

hint-marina-fewer.text: We have a few extra. Look at the marked pictures. Move left to take the extras away.

hint-pip-more.text: We need a few more. Look at the empty spaces. Move right to fill them.

hint-pip-fewer.text: We have a few extra. Look at the marked pictures. Move left to take the extras away.

hint-nova-more.text: We need a few more. Look at the empty spaces. Move right to fill them.

hint-nova-fewer.text: We have a few extra. Look at the marked pictures. Move left to take the extras away.

hint-spell.text: Look at the glowing sound space. Try saying the sounds together. Blue X takes the last one back.

hint-pattern.text: Look at the pictures that repeat. Say the pattern together, then try the next picture.

scrapbook.text: Our little discovery book. Choose a picture to hear a memory, or find a clue. Look for a golden star in the world, then press the green A button.

friend-gift.text: A thank-you present from your friend! You can put it in your home or garden. How lovely.

friend-gift-stars.text: Your friend has given you two extra stars. You already have this present, so you can choose something lovely from the shop.

discovery-welcome-daisy.text: A little daisy for our home. What shall we plant beside it?

discovery-clue-welcome-daisy.text: Look beside the garden at your house. Look for a golden star, then press the green A button.

discovery-pizza-tomato.text: Bramble saved a shiny tomato for the next pizza. What toppings would you choose?

discovery-clue-pizza-tomato.text: Look beside Bramble’s pizza shop. Look for a golden star, then press the green A button.

discovery-story-owl.text: A tiny owl ornament is watching the story tree. Shall we make up an owl adventure?

discovery-clue-story-owl.text: Look beside Olive’s story tree. Look for a golden star, then press the green A button.

discovery-harbour-boat.text: A little boat is ready for an imaginary voyage. Where shall it sail?

discovery-clue-harbour-boat.text: Look along the path beside Marina’s harbour. Look for a golden star, then press the green A button.

discovery-garden-flower.text: Tilly has picked a lovely flower for our book. Can you spot another flower nearby?

discovery-clue-garden-flower.text: Look beside Tilly’s growing patch. Look for a golden star, then press the green A button.

discovery-market-basket.text: A picnic basket! We could invite all our friends. What would you bring?

discovery-clue-market-basket.text: Look near Poppy’s little shops. Look for a golden star, then press the green A button.

discovery-rocket-bolt.text: Pip has found a spare bolt. It is a souvenir of our rocket adventure.

discovery-clue-rocket-bolt.text: Look along the path beside Pip’s rocket. Look for a golden star, then press the green A button.

discovery-woodland-mushroom.text: A mushroom beside a cosy woodland clearing. It looks like a tiny stool for a tiny friend.

discovery-clue-woodland-mushroom.text: From Olive, follow the trees towards the woodland lookout. Look for a golden star, then press the green A button.

discovery-sea-glass.text: A sparkling pebble beside the sea. Let’s leave the beach just as lovely as we found it.

discovery-clue-sea-glass.text: From Marina, follow the shore towards the lighthouse. Look for a golden star, then press the green A button.

discovery-meadow-star.text: A little wooden star is hiding in the meadow. What lovely thing shall we wish for?

discovery-clue-meadow-star.text: From Tilly, explore the meadow towards the windmill. Look for a golden star, then press the green A button.

discovery-moon-pebble.text: Our first Moon pebble! Let’s draw it in the book and remember our journey.

discovery-clue-moon-pebble.text: On the Moon, look beside the landing pad. Look for a golden star, then press the green A button.

discovery-moon-telescope.text: A telescope for our Moon camp. What would you like to look at in the sky?

discovery-clue-moon-telescope.text: On the Moon, explore just beyond Nova’s camp. Look for a golden star, then press the green A button.

garden-harvest.text: A basket for Bramble! Your plant can grow more. When a pizza needs your tomatoes or peppers, you will earn an extra star for each home-grown basket.

garden-full.text: Your baskets are full. Shall we visit Bramble and make a lovely pizza?

garden-visitors.text: Lovely flowers for our little visitors. Can you spot a bee, a bird, or a butterfly in your garden?

garden-pizza-success.text: You grew these in your own garden! What a lovely pizza. Here are some extra stars to say thank you.

delivery-route-woods.text: Olive is waiting by her story tree. Follow the golden star and press the green button to give her the pizza. Take your time.

delivery-route-garden.text: Tilly is waiting at her growing patch. Follow the golden star and press the green button to give her the pizza. Take your time.

delivery-route-cove.text: Marina is waiting by the harbour. Follow the golden star and press the green button to give her the pizza. Take your time.

delivery-route-rocket.text: Pip is waiting by his rocket. Follow the golden star and press the green button to give him the pizza. Take your time.

delivery-thanks-woods.text: A woodland pizza! What a lovely picnic for story time. Thank you for bringing it. Here is a star for you.

delivery-thanks-garden.text: My garden pizza is here! Just right for a little rest beside the flowers. Thank you. Here is a star for you.

delivery-thanks-cove.text: A harbour pizza! We can have a picnic and watch the boats. Thank you for bringing it. Here is a star for you.

delivery-thanks-rocket.text: My space pizza! Perfect for a picnic beside the rocket. Thank you, little explorer. Here is a star for you.

delivery-home.text: Your pizza is safe. Follow the golden star to the little rocket, and press the green button to fly home. Your friend is waiting on the island.

pip-chapter-panel.text: Oh dear, my rocket needs a little help. First, let us mend the control panel. Can you find the next shape in the pattern?

pip-chapter-fuel.text: The control panel is working! Now we need some shiny fuel crystals. Will you help me count them into the fuel tank?

pip-chapter-battery.text: The fuel tank is full! Just one more job. Let us add the power cells together to connect the star battery.

pip-repair-1.text: The control panel is mended! Look, the little buttons are working. Next, we can fill the fuel tank.

pip-repair-2.text: The fuel tank is full! Our rocket is nearly ready. Just the star battery to connect now.

pip-repair-3.text: You did it! All three systems are ready. Our rocket can fly to the Moon. Thank you, little explorer!

rover-intro.text: This little rover is yours to explore in! Press the green button to climb in. We can visit three expedition stops together.

rover-drive.text: Move the control pad to drive. Let go to stop. The green button can follow the star for you, or explore a stop when you arrive. The red button lets you climb out.

rover-exit.text: Here you are! Your rover will wait here. You can find it again on the picture map.

rover-next.text: Another little adventure! Follow the golden star to the next expedition stop. There is no hurry.

rover-success.text: What a careful explorer! Here is your expedition stamp, and one star. Shall we see what is at the next stop?

rover-route-rocks.text: Let us visit the rock trail. Follow the golden star to stop one.

rover-route-panels.text: Let us visit the sunshine station. Follow the golden star to stop two.

rover-route-signals.text: Let us visit signal hill. Follow the golden star to stop three.

rover-count-rocks.text: How many Moon rocks are in the tray? Count each picture once. Move the control pad to choose a number, then press the green button.

rover-count-panels.text: How many solar panels are in the tray? Count each picture once. Move the control pad to choose a number, then press the green button.

rover-count-signals.text: How many signal lights are in the tray? Count each picture once. Move the control pad to choose a number, then press the green button.

rover-follow.text: Off we go! Your rover is following the star. Move the control pad whenever you want to take over. The green button can stop the ride.

bramble-success-take-1.text: A pizza made by you! Thank you for helping in my kitchen.

bramble-success-take-2.text: Our customer has a lovely pizza. Here are your stars.

bramble-success-take-3.text: Ready to serve! You worked out the recipe. Thank you.

olive-success-take-1.text: You found it! Another little discovery for our story tree.

olive-success-take-2.text: That is it. Thank you for learning with me.

olive-success-take-3.text: A little bit of learning, and two stars to take home.

marina-success-take-1.text: All aboard! Thank you for helping at the harbour.

marina-success-take-2.text: That is just right for our little boat. Here are your stars.

marina-success-take-3.text: Our harbour job is done. Shall we see what comes next?

tilly-success-take-1.text: That is it! Thank you for helping in the growing patch.

tilly-success-take-2.text: Another little garden job finished. Here are your stars.

tilly-success-take-3.text: You worked it out. The garden is a lovely place to learn together.

pip-success-take-1.text: That is just what we needed. Thank you, little explorer.

pip-success-take-2.text: Our space team did it! Here are your stars.

pip-success-take-3.text: You worked it out. I wonder what we will discover next.

nova-success-take-1.text: A new discovery! Thank you for exploring with me.

nova-success-take-2.text: You found the answer. Here are two stars for your collection.

nova-success-take-3.text: That is it, little explorer. There is so much to find together.

bramble-retry-take-1.text: Have another look at the recipe. We can take our time.

bramble-retry-take-2.text: Let us check the pictures together, then try again.

olive-retry-take-1.text: Listen once more, and have another look at the letters.

olive-retry-take-2.text: We can try it together. Take your time and listen again.

marina-retry-take-1.text: Let us look at our harbour pictures again. There is no hurry.

marina-retry-take-2.text: Have another little look. We can work it out together.

tilly-retry-take-1.text: Let us look closely at the pictures. Take your time.

tilly-retry-take-2.text: We can have another go. What do you notice in the pictures?

pip-retry-take-1.text: Let us check those pictures again. Our rocket can wait.

pip-retry-take-2.text: Have another look, little explorer. There is no hurry.

nova-retry-take-1.text: Look at each picture, then listen to the question again.

nova-retry-take-2.text: There is time for another look. Which picture matches the question?

hint-bramble-more-take-1.text: Your number is a little low. Try moving right, then count again.

hint-bramble-more-take-2.text: Let us add a few more. The pictures will help us check.

hint-bramble-fewer-take-1.text: Your number is a little high. Move left, and check the pictures.

hint-bramble-fewer-take-2.text: Let us take the extras away. Move left, then have another look.

hint-tilly-more-take-1.text: Your number is a little low. Try moving right, then count again.

hint-tilly-more-take-2.text: Let us add a few more. The pictures will help us check.

hint-tilly-fewer-take-1.text: Your number is a little high. Move left, and check the pictures.

hint-tilly-fewer-take-2.text: Let us take the extras away. Move left, then have another look.

hint-marina-more-take-1.text: Your number is a little low. Try moving right, then count again.

hint-marina-more-take-2.text: Let us add a few more. The pictures will help us check.

hint-marina-fewer-take-1.text: Your number is a little high. Move left, and check the pictures.

hint-marina-fewer-take-2.text: Let us take the extras away. Move left, then have another look.

hint-pip-more-take-1.text: Your number is a little low. Try moving right, then count again.

hint-pip-more-take-2.text: Let us add a few more. The pictures will help us check.

hint-pip-fewer-take-1.text: Your number is a little high. Move left, and check the pictures.

hint-pip-fewer-take-2.text: Let us take the extras away. Move left, then have another look.

hint-nova-more-take-1.text: Your number is a little low. Try moving right, then count again.

hint-nova-more-take-2.text: Let us add a few more. The pictures will help us check.

hint-nova-fewer-take-1.text: Your number is a little high. Move left, and check the pictures.

hint-nova-fewer-take-2.text: Let us take the extras away. Move left, then have another look.

hint-spell-take-1.text: Try the glowing sound space again. Blue X takes the last sound back.

hint-spell-take-2.text: Listen to the sounds together. We can change the last one with the blue button.

hint-pattern-take-1.text: Look for the little group that repeats. What comes after it?

hint-pattern-take-2.text: Say the pattern slowly together. Which picture should come next?

rover-success-take-1.text: A stamp for your expedition book, and one star. Thank you for exploring.

rover-success-take-2.text: You counted the pictures. Here is your stamp and a star to take home.

rover-success-take-3.text: Another stop explored! Your stamp is in the book. Shall we keep going?

rover-more-take-1.text: Count the pictures in the tray. We need a bigger number.

rover-more-take-2.text: Your number is a little low. Move right, then count each picture once.

rover-more-take-3.text: Let us count them together. Try a bigger number when you are ready.

rover-fewer-take-1.text: Count the pictures in the tray. We need a smaller number.

rover-fewer-take-2.text: Your number is a little high. Move left, then count each picture once.

rover-fewer-take-3.text: Let us count them together. Try a smaller number when you are ready.

companions.text: Choose a little friend to come with you. Or let your friends rest at home. Green A chooses.

companion-sprig.text: This is Sprig, your little leafy friend. Sprig is coming on your adventure!

companion-puff.text: Puff loves the garden. Your little fluffy friend is coming with you!

companion-twinkle.text: Twinkle has come from the Moon to explore with you. What a lovely little friend!

companion-puff-locked.text: Puff loves growing things. Help Tilly in the garden, and Puff can join you.

companion-twinkle-locked.text: Twinkle lives on the Moon. Help Pip repair the rocket to meet your new friend.

companion-rest.text: Your friends are resting at home. You can choose a friend again whenever you like.

room-place.text: Choose something from your shelf. Choose a numbered space, then press green A to put it there.

room-turn.text: Choose a numbered space. Green A turns the thing in that space. You can turn it again if you like.

room-remove.text: Choose a numbered space. Green A puts that thing back on your shelf.

room-undo.text: Back just the way it was. You can try a different spot.
